response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT rfistat AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), b AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline FROM signals), k AS (SELECT g.status, g.avg_mod, b.baseline FROM g, b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline) SELECT COALESCE(status, 'No Status') AS rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - baseline AS diff_from_baseline, avg_mod - (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) FROM k) AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM k
